unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The primary XML/PDF cites Supplementary Tables 15 and 16 and a supplementary PDF, but the paper-local supplementary assets are ten Nature HTML landing-page .bin files; no local 41598_2019_39219_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, extracted supplementary PDF text, spreadsheet, or parsed supplementary table is present. Main-text XML tables support the repaired LD90/LD100/MIC rows, but several exact DBAASP broad-spectrum MIC/LC and HEK293 cytotoxicity rows remain supplement-only/database-only under the local-material contract.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Worker-2 activity rows are repaired from main XML, but worker-4 cannot source-verify all linked DBAASP exact assay/toxicity rows; worker-6 must leave the paper non-publication-grade with a targeted rework ticket.
